Title: App Routing Configuration
Summary: Application route definitions with hash-based routing and lazy-loaded feature components.
Content:
## Route Structure

The application uses Angular's `withHashLocation()` strategy, producing URLs like `/#/docs/getting-started`.

### Routes

| Path | Component | Lazy Loaded |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| `/` | `HomePageComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs` | `DocLayoutComponent` (with sidebar) | No |
| `/docs` (default child) | `DocsLandingComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs/getting-started` | `GettingStartedComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs/concepts` | `CoreConceptsComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs/api` | `ApiReferenceComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs/guides` | `GuidesComponent` | Yes |
| `/docs/faq` | `FaqComponent` | Yes |
| `**` | Redirects to `/` | — |

### DocLayoutComponent

All `/docs/*` routes render inside `DocLayoutComponent`, which provides:
- A sticky sidebar navigation with links to all doc sections
- Collapsible sidebar on mobile
- Active route highlighting via `routerLinkActive`

### Hash Location Strategy

Configured in `app.config.ts` via `provideRouter(routes, withHashLocation())`.
